È indicata per miopie da lievi a elevate con cornea adeguata; costa 4.900 € per entrambi gli occhi, 3.900 € fino a 35 anni, controlli inclusi. Tutti i dettagli nella pagina della SMILE .
Femto-LASIK
Con Femto-LASIK corsa e palestra si possono riprendere dopo circa 7 giorni dal trattamento; per il nuoto e gli sport d'acqua, e per gli sport di contatto come arti marziali e pugilato, si consiglia di attendere circa 4 settimane.
Se il difetto di vista è stabile, la probabilità che, dopo il trattamento, questo posso ripresentarsi è molto bassa. In questi rari casi, è possibile valutare un ritocco.
Con l’avanzare dell’età, possono subentrare problematiche, quali la cataratta, che nulla hanno a che vedere con i difetti di vista o il trattamento laser effettuato e che possono influenzare la qualità della visione. Queste situazioni andranno affrontate nel caso in futuro facessero la loro comparsa in modo mirato e specifico.
La Femto-LASIK comporta innumerevoli vantaggi rispetto alla PRK. Innanzitutto, è completamente indolore , inoltre, consente un recupero visivo pressoché immediato ed in poche ore il paziente torna a vedere nitido.
Inoltre, consente di trattare un maggior range di miopia ed anche di ipermetropia , associate eventualmente anche ad astigmatismo e presbiopia .
Molto spesso i due termini, per comodità, vengono utilizzati per indicare lo stesso trattamento.
Ma bisogna fare attenzione, perché, invece, in alcuni centri, il termine LASIK va a identificare un trattamento che si svolge seguendo gli stessi step della Femto-LASIK, ma la creazione del flap avviene tramite uno strumento meccanico manuale dotato di una tagliente (lama). Questo accade perché il centro non possiede un Laser a Femtosecondi (o Femtolaser), che ha invece evidentemente il grande vantaggio di garantire una precisione nell’ordine dei micron (millesimo di millimetro), cosa che uno strumento manuale non può avere.
Il Femtolaser è un investimento molto rilevante che non tutti i centri/oculisti possono permettersi di sostenere. L’alto valore di questi laser deriva proprio dalla tecnologia all’avanguardia tramite i quali sono progettati e che ha proprio lo scopo di garantirne, non solo l’efficacia, ma anche la sicurezza.
No, tutti i trattamenti laser correggono, durante lo stesso trattamento, anche l’astigmatismo.
PRK
Generalmente all’interno di ogni bando viene specificato quale tecnica laser è consentita per correggere i difetti visivi. La PRK è quella che viene praticamente sempre accettata. Da qualche anno, in molti concorsi, viene accettata anche la Femto-lasik.
Almeno una settimana.
Generalmente, dopo un trattamento laser, non sussiste più la necessità di portare lenti a contatto poiché il difetto di vista viene completamente corretto.
Va sottolineato, comunque, dopo qualsiasi trattamento laser è possibile portare lenti a contatto anche quelle estetiche colorate.
La vista potrà risultare annebbiata e si potrebbe sperimentare della sensibilità alla luce. Il recupero visivo completo si raggiunge solitamente durante la settimana successiva al trattamento.
Durante il trattamento non si avvertirà alcun fastidio poiché verranno instillate delle goccine di collirio anestetico.
Dopo la PRK è possibile avvertire dolore e fastidio, che si attenuano fino a scomparire in genere entro 2-3 giorni dal trattamento, con l'aiuto di colliri e di una lente a contatto protettiva.
Presbyond
La Presbyond è un trattamento atto a correggere la presbiopia, che tipicamente insorge attorno ai 40 anni. Quindi, prima dell’età interessata dalla presbiopia, si prediligono altre tecniche per correggere i difetti visivi. Dopo, invece, non ci sono limiti di età. Se si ha un cristallino sano e trasparente, ci si può sottoporre alla Presbyond anche a 75 anni!
No, la Presbyond corregge, durante lo stesso trattamento: presbiopia, astigmatismo, miopia ed ipermetropia, in qualunque modo associati tra loro.
Si provvederà a risolvere la cataratta, esattamente come avviene per chi non ha fatto trattamenti laser agli occhi, con un intervento nel quale il cristallino affetto da cataratta viene sostituito con una lente artificiale perfettamente biocompatibile, che verrà scelta appositamente per garantire la stessa qualità visiva che si aveva prima che dell’insorgere della cataratta stessa.
No, prima del trattamento vengono applicate delle goccine di collirio anestetico, che rendono il trattamento completamente indolore. Subito dopo, si potrà avvertire una sensazione di corpo estraneo, come sabbia, negli occhi e un leggero fastidio, che comunque entro sera si risolve.
È necessario effettuare una visita di idoneità presso uno dei nostri centri. Durante questa visita, verrà in primis accerto lo stato di benessere dei vostri occhi e poi si effettueranno una serie di test ed esami non invasivi, non a contatto con l’occhio e non dolorosi mirati a capire se si sia idonei al trattamento laser Presbyond. Durante questa visita, verranno instillate le goccine per dilatare la pupilla, il cui effetto si esaurisce entro 3 o 4 ore.
È la perdita progressiva della capacità di mettere a fuoco da vicino, dovuta all'irrigidimento del cristallino. Compare in genere tra i 42 e i 48 anni e riguarda tutti, anche chi non ha mai portato occhiali.
Approfondisci: Presbiopia: sintomi e soluzioni
Con Presbyond Laser Blended Vision (Zeiss): un occhio viene ottimizzato per la distanza e l'altro per il vicino, con una zona di fusione intermedia che il cervello integra. È indicato in genere tra i 45 e i 60 anni.
Approfondisci: Presbyond
5.500 euro per entrambi gli occhi, controlli post-operatori inclusi per 6 mesi.
Presbyond Laser Blended Vision è il trattamento laser Zeiss per la presbiopia. Con la Femto-LASIK l'occhio dominante viene ottimizzato per la distanza e l'altro leggermente per il vicino, aumentando in entrambi la profondità di campo: il cervello fonde le due immagini e si vede bene da lontano, a distanza intermedia e da vicino. Rispetto alla vecchia monovisione la differenza tra i due occhi è minore e viene tollerata dalla grande maggioranza dei pazienti.
Corregge insieme presbiopia e miopia, ipermetropia o astigmatismo, con il cristallino naturale che resta al suo posto. Costa 5.500 € per entrambi gli occhi. Approfondisci Presbyond .
Presbiopia tra i 40 e i 50 anni
Intorno ai 45 anni le braccia sembrano troppo corte per leggere: è la presbiopia. Ecco cosa si può fare, con e senza laser, in questa fascia di età.
Quasi sempre è presbiopia: il cristallino perde elasticità e non mette più a fuoco da vicino. Compare tra i 40 e i 50 anni, progredisce fino ai 60-65 e riguarda tutti. Non è una malattia e non peggiora la vista da lontano. Una visita oculistica serve però a distinguerla da un inizio di cataratta o da altri difetti e a misurare quanta correzione serve. Approfondisci la presbiopia .
Sì, e per molti è il momento migliore per decidere, perché il difetto è stabile da anni. Va però tenuto conto della presbiopia in arrivo: correggere solo la miopia con il laser significa vedere bene da lontano ma avere bisogno degli occhiali da vicino, come chi non è mai stato miope. Per chi vuole ridurre anche la dipendenza dagli occhiali da lettura esiste Presbyond, che corregge insieme i due difetti. In visita si simulano i due scenari con lenti di prova. Leggi anche a che età ci si può operare .
Presbyond Laser Blended Vision è un trattamento Femto-LASIK Zeiss che ottimizza un occhio per la distanza e l'altro leggermente per il vicino, aumentando la profondità di campo di entrambi: il cervello fonde le immagini e si vede a tutte le distanze. È indicato tra i 45 e i 60 anni circa, con cristallino ancora trasparente, per miopi, ipermetropi e astigmatici; non è adatto a chi ha già una cataratta iniziale. Costa 5.500 € per entrambi gli occhi. Approfondisci Presbyond .
Tutte e tre le strade funzionano; cambiano comodità e durata. Gli occhiali progressivi sono la soluzione più semplice e reversibile; le lenti a contatto multifocali danno libertà ma richiedono tolleranza e cura; il laser (Presbyond) è la scelta di chi vuole indipendenza dagli occhiali per i prossimi 10-15 anni, sapendo che con l'evoluzione naturale del cristallino potrà servire un aggiustamento. La sostituzione del cristallino con una lente multifocale è invece riservata a chi ha già una cataratta iniziale, di solito dopo i 55-60 anni.
Nulla che impedisca di operarla: la cataratta si tratta normalmente, sostituendo il cristallino con una lente intraoculare calcolata con formule dedicate agli occhi già operati con il laser. In quel momento si può scegliere una lente che mantenga l'indipendenza dagli occhiali. Il trattamento laser fatto anni prima non è un ostacolo. Leggi l'intervento di cataratta .
ICL
Le ICL (Implantable Collamer Lens) sono lenti intraoculari impiantabili utilizzate per correggere difetti visivi come la miopia, l'ipermetropia e l'astigmatismo. Vengono inserite chirurgicamente all'interno dell'occhio per migliorare la messa a fuoco e ridurre o eliminare la dipendenza da occhiali o lenti a contatto.
Candidati ideali per l'ICL sono persone con difetti visivi moderati o severi che desiderano una correzione permanente, con un'altissima qualità visiva, eventualmente anche in presenza di cornea sottile o difetti visivi elevati. La valutazione del candidato dipenderà dalla salute oculare complessiva e dalla stabilità del difetto visivo nel tempo.
La procedura chirurgica dell'ICL è un intervento che di solito richiede circa 15-20 minuti per occhio. Durante l'intervento, la lente ICL viene posizionata dietro l'iride, fornendo una correzione visiva immediata e reversibile.
La procedura ICL è generalmente indolore, in quanto vengono instillate gocce di collirio anestetico. Alcuni pazienti possono sperimentare un lieve disagio nelle prime ore dopo l'intervento, ma questo è di solito gestibile con farmaci per il dolore raccomandati dal medico.
La maggior parte dei pazienti sperimenta un recupero visivo rapido dopo l'intervento ICL. La maggior parte delle attività quotidiane può essere ripresa entro pochi giorni, e la visione continuerà a migliorare nel corso delle settimane successive.
Da 5.900 a 8.700 euro per entrambi gli occhi secondo il tipo di lente (sferica o torica); da 3.000 euro per un solo occhio. Listino in vigore dal 2 settembre 2026.
Sì, è reversibile: la lente può essere rimossa o sostituita, ad esempio quando in età avanzata si opera la cataratta.
Circa 15 minuti per occhio; la visione è già nitida entro 24-48 ore. Il Dott. Russo ha pubblicato con il Prof. Savini studi sulla previsione della posizione della lente ICL (vault) con intelligenza artificiale.
Sopra circa 8-10 diottrie di miopia, o con una cornea sottile, le lenti ICL sono di solito la scelta più sicura: si impiantano dietro l'iride senza rimuovere tessuto corneale, danno una qualità visiva molto alta anche di notte, correggono fino a circa 18 diottrie e sono reversibili. Il laser resta preferibile per miopie basse e medie con cornea adeguata, perché non richiede di entrare nell'occhio.
Al GRI la scelta si fa in visita su spessore corneale, entità del difetto e profondità della camera anteriore. Le lenti ICL costano da 5.900 €: dettagli nella pagina delle lenti ICL .
Cataratta
La maggior parte dei pazienti può riprendere le normali attività quotidiane entro 24h dall'intervento. Tuttavia, è importante seguire le indicazioni post-operatorie per garantire una pronta guarigione e massimizzare i risultati.
Molti pazienti sperimentano un miglioramento della visione immediato dopo l'intervento. Tuttavia, è normale sperimentare alcune variazioni prima che la visione si stabilizzi completamente nel periodo post-operatorio.
Con il laser a femtosecondi, che esegue le incisioni e la frammentazione del cristallino con precisione micrometrica, e con l'impianto di una lente intraoculare. Circa 10-15 minuti per occhio, in anestesia con collirio, senza degenza.
Approfondisci: Cataratta: guida completa
Da 3.400 euro per un occhio con lente monofocale (6.600 euro entrambi gli occhi) fino a 8.600 euro per entrambi gli occhi con lenti premium toriche o EDOF. Listino 2026.
Di norma a distanza di 1-2 settimane, così il primo occhio guida la scelta della lente per il secondo.
Monofocale per vedere bene da lontano (occhiali per vicino), torica se c'è astigmatismo, EDOF o multifocale per ridurre la dipendenza dagli occhiali a tutte le distanze. La scelta si basa su biometria e abitudini visive.
In media tra i 65 e i 75 anni, ma il momento giusto dipende da quanto la vista limita le attività quotidiane, non dall'età anagrafica.
La cataratta non torna, ma nel 20-30% dei casi si opacizza la capsula dietro la lente (cataratta secondaria): si risolve in pochi minuti con un laser YAG ambulatoriale.
La visione migliora già nelle prime 24-48 ore e si stabilizza in alcune settimane. Le normali attività quotidiane si riprendono in genere il giorno successivo.
No: si esegue in anestesia con collirio e non è doloroso. Nelle ore successive si può avvertire un lieve fastidio o sensazione di sabbia, che si risolve da sé.
Il giorno dell’intervento occorre essere accompagnati. Si torna a guidare dopo pochi giorni, quando la vista si è stabilizzata e l’oculista lo conferma al controllo.
Nel 20-30% dei casi la capsula dietro la lente artificiale si opacizza a distanza di mesi o anni. Si risolve in pochi minuti, ambulatorialmente, con un laser YAG.
Sì. Serve un calcolo della lente intraoculare più accurato, che eseguiamo con metodi dedicati agli occhi già sottoposti a chirurgia refrattiva.
Al Gruppo Refrattivo Italiano si opera con il laser a femtosecondi, che esegue incisioni, apertura della capsula e frammentazione del cristallino con precisione micrometrica.
Circa 10-15 minuti per occhio. Tra preparazione e riposo si resta in clinica circa due ore e si torna a casa lo stesso giorno, accompagnati.
Si opera quando riduce la qualità della vita, per esempio nella guida notturna o nella lettura. Aspettare troppo rende il cristallino più duro e l’intervento tecnicamente più impegnativo.
Al Centro Oculistico Bresciano, la sede GRI di Via dei Mille 14 a Brescia, a cinque minuti a piedi dalla stazione: intervento con laser a femtosecondi, ambulatoriale, lenti monofocali, toriche ed EDOF. Costi, percorso e come arrivare sono nella pagina intervento di cataratta a Brescia .
Nella sede GRI di Via Giovanni Motta 37 a Bergamo, a cinque minuti di taxi dall’aeroporto di Orio al Serio e a 50 km da Milano: stessa tecnica con laser a femtosecondi, stesse lenti e stesso listino della sede di Brescia (da 3.400 euro per un occhio, da 6.600 a 8.600 euro per entrambi). Dettagli nella pagina intervento di cataratta a Bergamo .
Il Servizio Sanitario Nazionale copre l’intervento con lente monofocale. La chirurgia con laser a femtosecondi e le lenti premium, che correggono anche astigmatismo e presbiopia, restano a carico del paziente e sono detraibili al 19%.
Dipende dalla lente intraoculare scelta. Con la lente monofocale si vede bene da lontano e servono gli occhiali da vicino; la lente torica corregge anche l'astigmatismo; la lente EDOF dà una buona visione da lontano e a distanza intermedia (computer, cruscotto) e lascia gli occhiali solo per i caratteri più piccoli; la lente trifocale o multifocale offre l'indipendenza quasi completa dagli occhiali, con possibili aloni notturni nei primi mesi.
Al GRI il costo va da 6.600 € (monofocale) a 8.600 € (EDOF torica) per entrambi gli occhi, da 3.400 € per un occhio, controlli inclusi per 6 mesi. La lente più adatta si sceglie in visita in base a occhi e abitudini. Approfondisci l'intervento di cataratta .

Cupidとは
Cupid（クピド：社会福祉法人クピド・フェア）は、北海道・岩見沢市を拠点とした、 さまざまな人たちの自立した生活と社会への参加を目的に設立された社会福祉法人です。 そこには、入所・通所施設のほか、芸術工房、レストラン、ギャラリー、診療所、コンビニ、住宅などが 点在し、まさに“ひとつの町”というべき環境のなかで、多くの人たちが共に暮らしています。
いちばん先の、しあわせへ。
世の中には、いろんな人が生きている。そのすべての人生は、尊く、かけがえのないもの。 だからこそ手にしたい。やりたいと思ったことができる自由を。 仕事を通して人の期待に応える喜びを。仲間と笑い、泣き、感動をともにする楽しさを。 さまざまな人とつながり、心を通わせるとき、 違いを認めあうのは、「必要」ではなく「あたり前」のことだと私たちは考える。 それはお互いが自分のできることで、現実の重みを少しずつシェアするということ。 そこには、よりよい世界をつくり出しているという純粋な喜びがある。 年齢も、性別も、障害も、あらゆる境界を越えて、すべての人が思い通りに人生を楽しむ。 そんな、あたり前のしあわせにあふれた、最先端の世の中をめざして。 クピドはこれからも、自分たちができることを、ひとつずつ積み重ねていきます。

History
2016 This year was marked by the merger process of four insurance companies. On 2 November, Zavarovalnica Sava insurance company started operating. It has a 5-member Management Board, and is lead by mag. David Kastelic.
2016
2017 In 2017, the Zavarovalnica Sava insurance company operated for the first time the entire year as a new insurance company after the successful merger. With a new approach to the market and by placing the insured person in the focus of our business operation, we enriched our offer of products with a new health insurance Zdravje at the end of 2017, and thus successfully entered the market of health insurances. By expanding the portfolio of our insurances, we are becoming even more accessible to our policyholders and offer them a comprehensive package in all areas.
2017

In 2018, we signed a purchase agreement for the purchase of a 100% share of the companies ERGO osiguranje and Ergo iivotno osiguranje in the Croatian market, where our subsidiary operates. By developing our own assistance service, we put our policyholders even more in the focus point of our attention.

The year 2019 is also marked by the new reorganisation, collective agreement and the purchase of a 100% share in Ergo osiguranje and Egro životno osiguranje insurance companies and their merger with the Croatian branch Sava osiguranje.

Achieved planned objectives in 2025
Business volume, as measured by gross premiums written, increased year on year in both the Slovenian and Croatian markets. We exceeded the planned gross premium volume by 1.7%, or EUR 11.2 million. Net profit for the year totalled EUR 68.9 million, exceeding the plan by 62.4% and the previous year by EUR 21.0 million. The net result achieved in Croatia was also positive, at EUR 0.2 million, against EUR 0.6 million in the previous year.
While 2023 and 2024 were heavily impacted by natural catastrophes, 2025 was characterised by low natural catastrophe activity and a significantly lower impact on profit than in previous years. Gross claims paid for natural catastrophes totalled EUR 22.6 million, impacting the year’s profit by EUR 16.6 million.
Gross operating expenses were higher than planned. The gross expense ratio deteriorated, rising by 0.6 percentage points to 25.2%. The insurance service result (excluding non-attributable expenses) was EUR 32.6 million above plan, driven by lower insurance service expenses and higher insurance revenue.
In Slovenia and Croatia, we are introducing a new core IT support to upgrade and replace our older systems. Given the scale of the project, its implementation will continue over the coming years.
The credit rating agency S&P Global Ratings upgraded the company’s financial strength rating to “A+” with a stable outlook.

ABOUT US Centre A: Vancouver International Centre for Contemporary Asian Art is a leading nonprofit art gallery currently situated in the heart of Vancouver’s Chinatown, on the unceded territories of the Musqueam, Squamish, and Tsleil-Waututh peoples. It is a registered charity and the only public art gallery in Canada
About Us
Centre A: Vancouver International Centre for Contemporary Asian Art is a leading nonprofit art gallery currently situated in the heart of Vancouver’s Chinatown, on the unceded territories of the Musqueam, Squamish, and Tsleil-Waututh peoples. It is a registered charity and the only public art gallery in Canada dedicated to contemporary Asian and Asian-diasporic perspectives since 1999.
Vision: A society where people and art of a multiplicity of cultures and communities are respected, represented, and empowered.
Mission Statement: Centre A uplifts globalized Asian experiences through contemporary art, multi-disciplinary practices, and critical engagement and dialogue.
Mandate: Centre A produces exhibitions of contemporary Asian art, develops innovative public programs, and creates ongoing learning opportunities for artists, cultural workers and organizations.
Values: We lead with compassion, empathy, and respect in our pursuit to uplift and represent diverse voices.
COMMITMENT
Centre A is committed to providing a platform for engaging diverse communities through public access to the arts, creating mentorship opportunities for emerging artists and arts professionals, and stimulating critical dialogue through provocative exhibitions and innovative public programs that complicate understandings of migrant experiences and diasporic communities.
Centre A’s mandate is to be an engaged participant in the ongoing production of a pluralistic and democratic society. We strive to activate contemporary art’s vital role in building and understanding the long and dynamic Asia-Canada relationship while tackling questions of broader concern from Asian and Asian-diasporic perspectives. Amidst the absence of institutional commitment in Canada to contemporary art as a vital site for social engagement and critical cultural production in local, migrant, and global Asian contexts, the gallery has continued to be dedicated to:
Supporting the creation of new works by Asian and Asian-diasporic artists in Canada, particularly emerging artists and artists within the Asian milieu whose voices are underrepresented due to the particular intersectional spaces that they occupy; facilitating collaboration and creative exchange between Asian artists in Canada and abroad, in order to engage critically with local, regional and national concerns from a global perspective; fostering meaningful relationships with local arts organizations, collectives, community organizations and groups within the Asian community and beyond; and engaging meaningfully with the call for Reconciliation and contribute to the understanding and navigation of non-European settler identities from Asian perspectives. While we play an active role in community enlivenment and conviviality, we are a means for broader cultural productivity; a local and transnational community-building apparatus that acts as a conduit for the contest of ideas and a site for the contemplation of issues of contemporary concern.
In addition to our exhibition space, we house a reading room with one of the best collections of Asian art books in the country, including the Finlayson Collection of Rare Asian Art Books. In these facilities and beyond, we rigorously engage in culture-making through research, curatorial engagement with artists, mentorship of emerging arts professionals, presentation of works, public dialogues, and various forms of documentation.
HISTORY
Centre A was founded in 1999 by Hank Bull (Founding Director), Zheng Shengtian and Stephanie Holmquist, who assembled an all-star board consisting of such distinguished figures as Milton Wong, Joanne Louie Mah, Joe Wai and Anndraya Luui. Through their, and subsequent boards’ leadership, as well as the contributions of our curators and directors (Sadira Rodrigues, Alice Ming Wai Jim, Makiko Hara, Haema Sivanesan, Tyler Russell, Yun-Jou Chang, Henry Heng Lu, Ellie Chung, and Jenie Gao), and a robust list of donors, volunteers, interns and staff, Centre A continues to make an important impact on Vancouver’s art scene and community at large. Over the years, Centre A has worked with countless artists including Yoko Ono, Ho Tam, Vanessa Kwan, Young Hae Chang Heavy Industries, Hong Kong Exile, Samson Young, Khan Lee and Subodh Gupta. Additionally, we have collaborated with numerous organizations, locally and internationally, such as the National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts, Or Gallery, the Vancouver Art Gallery, and Long March.

Reading Room - About
READING ROOM
The reading room and library at Centre A began in 1999 with contributions from artists, researchers, and curators both locally in Vancouver and internationally. The reading room emerged out of the need to collect a body of literature on Asian art practices, and by extension creating transnational ties with international arts communities. Past curators at Centre A have made significant contributions in collecting publications that reflect and engage in conversations concerning contemporary Asian and Asian diasporic art practices, and the artistic relationships between North America and Asia.
Access our online database HERE .
Centre A’s reading room includes the Fraser Finlayson Collection of rare books on Classical Chinese and Japanese Art with publications dating back to the late 19th century. Included in the reading room are also recent publications that have been donated by galleries, artists and artists collectives, and curators. In addition, we house monographs, artist ephemera, exhibition catalogues, art criticism writings, and artist’s books that have contributed to the diverse livelihood and possibilities of the reading room as a site of cultural production.
Some publications in the reading room include books by Ai Weiwei, Santiago Bose, Yayoi Kusama, Mona Hatoum, Reena Saimi Kallat, as well as other notable artists. Researchers, curators, artists and art institutions have generously contributed to the reading room to enrich the democratization of literature, the production of knowledge, and maintaining the reading room as an accessible public resource in Vancouver’s Chinatown. At Centre A, we house an array of publications that have been created for public programming initiatives that have engaged Vancouver’s arts community. These publications have been critical in facilitating dialogues and conversations concerning globalization, cultural identity, and the role of the arts under various political conditions.

=== PAGE: about us | https://byjasco.com/pages/about-us
About Us – Jasco
Retrieved via http: https://byjasco.com/pages/about-us
About Us
Our Story
Since 1975 when our founder, Steve Trice, started Jasco, our mission has been to serve others by continually exceeding customer expectations and reinventing product categories with innovations that enhance people’s lives and give back to the world.
While providing our retail and online partners far-reaching product assortments, we use our commitment to design, research and development to bring to market a steady flow of product innovations in home automation, lighting, home entertainment, power and mobility products under powerful brands.
With every product that is sold, we aim to help make a difference in people's lives and that doesn't stop at checkout . As a company, we are blessed to donate 50% of net profits from Jasco's brands* to ministries and charities, an initiative that started over two decades ago and has only continued to grow.
Now under the leadership of Steve's sons, Jason and Cameron Trice, together with our family of team members at Jasco, our hope is to create meaningful, lasting relationships with our customers, who know that every purchase makes a difference in someone’s life.
We Believe In...
The power of one God
Jasco will be stewarded by biblical principles, beginning everything with prayer, and giving our time, talent and treasure to the glory of God. (1 Chronicles 29:11-12)
The value of one person
Jasco endeavors to become a stepping stone in a team members' paths to realize their full potential by providing opportunities to grow spiritually, personally, and professionally. (2 Corinthians 5:15)
The leverage of one team
By valuing each individual, we will become focused on serving others rather than ourselves, allowing us to be a more cohesive and effective team that is greater than the sum of the individual parts. (Ecclesiastes 4:9-12)
We're Celebrating 50 Years of Innovation!
Jasco has been committed to honoring God and serving others through everything we do. That foundation of faith has guided us through five decades of innovation, growth, and impact. Today, we celebrate 50 years in business and more than $275 million in charitable contributions, transforming profits into purpose and lives around the world.
How We Got Here: A 50-Year Journey
Jasco Through The Years
1975
Jasco Is Born
Founded by Steve Trice on July 15th, Jasco began as a division of Trice Wholesale Electronics in a 1,400 sq. ft. space, initially marketing CB radio accessories. This humble start laid the groundwork for the company’s future growth and innovation.
1977
Jasco Becomes Independent After Early Wins
After landing some initial customers including the then 50-store Target and 50-store Walmart chain, Steve purchases Jasco from Trice Electronics and Jasco becomes an independent business.
1983
Jasco Breaks Ground
As the business grows, Jasco finds itself in need of more space. Jasco breaks ground on a 40,000 sq. ft. office and warehouse in Oklahoma City, just down the street from our current location.
1994
Jasco's First Brand Deals with Emerson and Bell
Jasco licenses the Emerson brand for audio-video accessories and the Bell brand for phone accessories. This was Jasco's first venture into brand partnerships that would ultimately become a hallmark of the company and help create a competitive advantage.
1998
Jasco Launches Long-Term GE Brand Partnership
Jasco licenses the GE brand for consumer electronics, consolidating audio-video products and phone accessories under one premiere national brand. This was the start of a successful long-term brand partnership with General Electric.
2004
Jasco Expands with New Headquarters and Major GE Acquisition
Jasco purchases a 60-acre property featuring a 40,000 sq. ft. distribution center and office space to support rapid business growth, establishing its new headquarters. The company also acquires GE’s Home Electrical Products division. This acquisition extends the GE brand license to 15 new product categories and more than doubles Jasco’s size overnight.
2008
Jasco Expands Headquarters After Years of Strong Growth
Based on multiple years of double-digit business growth, Jasco breaks ground on a expansion of its corporate headquarters, adding over 17,000 sq. ft. in both office and distribution center space on this campus.
2009
Jasco Launches Projectables, a Breakthrough in Nightlight Innovation
Jasco develops and launches Projectables, a groundbreaking nightlight technology featuring beloved animated characters through partnerships with Disney, Pixar, Marvel, DC Comics, and Nickelodeon. From 2010–2012 and beyond, Projectables grew rapidly and are now sold in virtually every major U.S. retailer.
2015
Jasco Launches Enbrighten Brand
Jasco launches Enbrighten as an independent brand with premium, shatterproof LED café lights designed for year-round use. The line quickly expands to include color-changing and landscape lights, eventually growing into a full range of high-end LED lighting products like linear fixtures, pucks, and lanterns.
2016
Jasco Expands Portfolio with Philips and Energizer License
Jasco licenses major brands Philips and Energizer, expanding its portfolio with products ranging from consumer electronics to LED lighting. These partnerships diversify offerings and create opportunities for customer differentiation and channel segmentation.
2017
Jasco Rolls Out Strategic E-Commerce Growth Initiative
Jasco launched a strategic e-commerce growth initiative focused on strengthening its digital footprint and meeting the rising demands of online consumers. This effort included optimizing product content, improving digital merchandising, and expanding its presence across major retailer websites.
2020
Jasco Champions Charity with 'Give Your Way' Initiative
Jasco launches the "Give Your Way" campaign across all its owned brands, making a bold and transparent commitment to donate 50% of company profits to charitable causes. This initiative not only reinforces Jasco’s long-standing mission of giving back but also empowers customers by allowing them to help choose which charities receive support.
2022
Jasco Enters Warehouse Automation
Jasco opens a $40 million state-of-the-art automated distribution center to boost scalability, delivery efficiency, and maintain its competitive edge. Designed with employees in mind, the facility enhances safety, reduces physical strain, and offers opportunities for skill development and growth.
2023
JascoPro Brand Launches in Wholesale Channels
Jasco launches its new brand, JascoPro, as a key focus to winning in the wholesale, builder and contractor channels. These custom-crafted product solutions are professional-grade quality designed to enhance aesthetics within and outside the home.
2025
Jasco Launches Strauto Brand
Jasco launches Strauto, a new brand focused on the automotive and travel industries as part of its diversification strategy. Strauto offers reliable products for life on the go while supporting Jasco’s mission to donate 50% of profits to charitable causes.
Get to Know Us
What started in the corner of a family business has grown to an international staple. Jasco has evolved over the years, but family is still a driving force behind everything we do. You know us whether you realize it or not. In fact, you probably have our products in several rooms of your home. Since 1975, we’ve created more than 4,000 products and received over 30 patents. Our award-winning products are in more than 100 million homes and over 85,000 retail locations.

As our business has expanded over the years, so have our efforts to give back. 50% of net profits from Jasco's brands* are donated to charity. We are passionate about investing our time and resources in helping develop, strengthen and maintain our communities.
Sustainability
Our packaging, sourcing and recycling practices have been carefully crafted to advance our goal of environmental responsibility. Learn more about how we are striving to make the world a cleaner place for all who call it home.
Inspiration to Innovation
Do you have a Jasco product in your home without even knowing it?
Behind the scenes, we design and develop products to simplify your life and connect your home. Through innovation, strong consumer care and unsurpassed quality, Jasco builds powerful brands and has developed a reputation as a valuable partner of top international brands throughout the world.

Discover some lesser-known facts about Ernest Solvay, the scientist and entrepreneur who founded Solvay 160 years ago.
5 little-known facts about Ernest Solvay
Not your typical scientist
Ernest Solvay founded the company that bears his name in 1863, exactly 160 years ago! And so all year long, we’re celebrating the hyperactive scientist and entrepreneur, well known as an inventor, a patron of sciences and a promoter of social progress. But, wait, here are a few other things about him you probably didn’t know…
1. He hadn’t planned to found Solvay
Ernest Solvay wanted to sell his chemical process , but his original patent was invalidated, so he had to create his own company to exploit it.
2. He was fired by his own uncle
His first job was at a gasworks owned by his uncle, but he spent most of his time working on personal projects. His uncle eventually fired him, giving him free time to launch Solvay & Cie.
3. He opposed the concept of inheritance
With political views combining liberalism and socialism, he declared that “society is obligated to strive for social justice or else it will die”, and supported total equality for all.
4. He supported Marie Curie’s research
A major patron of sciences, he was curious about radioactivity and financed a series of Marie Curie ’s experiments. Check this out!
5. The highest refuge in the Alps bears his name
An enthusiastic mountain climber, he financed the construction of the Solvay refuge on the Matterhorn in Switzerland.
After 160 years, Ernest Solvay’s scientific, industrial and social legacy lives on, and we are proud to uphold it!

Solvay teams up with Bridgestone and Arlanxeo to develop a more sustainable tire technology platform.
A tire technology platform to drive the future of sustainable mobility
TECHSYN: developed by Solvay, Bridgestone, and Arlanxeo for more fuel-efficient tires
Developing a new type of tire is a lengthy and complex process. Which makes it all the more impressive that TECHSYN was co-created by Bridgestone , Solvay and Arlanxeo in only 24 months. The three companies, respectively one of the world’s major tire manufacturers, the global leader in highly dispersible silica and the leading producer of synthetic rubber, put together their expertise with one shared objective: to create a tire that helps accelerate the transition to more sustainable mobility.
Better wear & rolling resistance for lower emissions
TECHSYN is not a product, but a technology platform. It’s a new compound of elastomers and silica that enables the manufacturing of tires for all categories of vehicles, with a highly improved sustainability profile. These tires will last 30% longer while offering 6% less rolling resistance. In other words, TECHSYN creates “a tire that can go further for longer,” as the official motto says.
As reduced rolling resistance has a direct impact on diminishing a vehicle’s fuel consumption and emissions, TECHSYN provides an additional tool for mobility to become more sustainable. And since these more resistant tires last longer, it also enables a reduction in raw material consumption. But the key is to offer these benefits without compromising on other aspects of the tire’s performance.
“We need to transition to sustainable mobility faster, and collaboration provides more efficiency and therefore rapidity.”
Nicolas Cudre-Mauroux CTO, Solvay
The chemistry between silica, rubber and people
Herein lies TECHSYN’s real breakthrough. By optimizing the interactions between the synthetic rubber and tailor-made silica and improving the compound design in which they are combined, TECHSYN enables the redistribution of the tire’s main benefits – rolling resistance, wet grip and wear resistance. Plus, it can be used in combination with other tire technologies.
In a world where mobility urgently needs to come up with solutions that have a positive impact on sustainability, TECHSYN demonstrates that companies collaborating together can achieve what would be impossible alone. “We need to transition to sustainable mobility faster, and collaboration provides more efficiency, and therefore, rapidity,” sums up Nicolas Cudre-Mauroux , Solvay’s CTO. “All three companies brought something unique here, because each one is an expert in its field. The first step is to align on an objective: there must be a reason to collaborate. Then, the special chemistry can happen, not just between silica and rubber, but also between people.”
Only the beginning for enhanced sustainability
Today, all the final adjustments have been made and the mass production of TECHSYN tires for various categories is ready to take off. What’s more, TECHSYN was recently recognized as one of Solvay’s prime breakthroughs at the Group’s 2022 Innovation Awards, where it took the prize in the “Customer Partnership Innovation” category. But that doesn’t mean the story is over.
The three companies share a joint technology roadmap to continue exploring the full potential of this platform and take it to the next level. “Sustainability is a key driver for our three companies, and we need to do more,” says Emilio. “Developing TECHSYN is a great step but not the end of our collaboration: it’s going to enable us to continue enhancing our sustainability agenda.”
“It would be unthinkable not to pursue our work together into a snowball effect for more applications,” adds Nicolas. “This is only the beginning.”

About Solvay
A 160+ year legacy of bringing progress to our planet and society
At Solvay, we are Essential Chemistry, making progress possible for generations. This is our purpose, our compass.
We produce essential chemicals that are key ingredients in everyday products. These products include glass, batteries, healthcare, food, electronics, and clean energy solutions.
We combine strong technology expertise with continuous process innovation to deliver more sustainable and competitive solutions. As demand grows for responsible products, we focus on applications that support a thriving future. These include cleaner mobility, resource efficiency, and environmental protection.
Innovation is part of our DNA. From early soda ash to advanced peroxide technologies and circular silica for tires, we keep reinventing Essential Chemistry production. We improve performance, reduce impact, and strengthen our leadership in global markets.
We are not just adapting to change. We are shaping the future of our industry, advancing sustainable chemistry and setting new standards for generations to come.
Solvay's 2025 key figures
Our strategy: a leader in Essential Chemistry
Our strategy stems from a distinctive position at the crossroads of scale and specialization. We focus on what drives our value: market leadership, cost leadership and sustainability.
These key assets work together to create a unique competitive edge. Thus they deliver reliable, large-scale, and more sustainable chemistry. They also keep improving efficiency and overall impact.
Four strategic levers guide our investments and priorities, and two enablers underpin our strategy:
our people, whose expertise and engagement drive our performance, supported by a culture designed to accelerate change; and
our operating model, with strong central governance, ensuring focus, discipline and efficiency across the Group.
Together, they help transform Solvay into a simpler, more cost-efficient, and sustainable company. This supports our ambition to lead in Essential Chemistry.

Solvay's three core value drivers:
Across all our businesses, Solvay benefits from strong product know-how and expertise. We lead in process technology, supported by continuous innovation. This is integral to our performance as it supports our market presence and our cost-competitiveness.
Solvay has a high-quality and focused portfolio of key industry assets. It includes five global technologies: soda ash and bicarbonate, peroxides, silica, fluorine, and rare earths. It also has a strong regional business in Latin America that focuses on solvents and the polyamide chain.
These businesses are structured around two segments:
Basic Chemicals (Soda Ash & Derivatives and Peroxides businesses): our products serve many industries. They support stable, resilient markets where Solvay is a trusted reference. a strong product expertise and leading process technology strengthened by continuous innovation,
a well-balanced network of global and regional manufacturing plants, near our customers, with strong supply chains, and
our strong brand, linked to the quality and reliability of our products.

Do you work in a toxic company? Watch out for these signs!
1 Your colleagues complain incessantly
2 Daily arguments and insults
3 Everyone is looking for a job
4 No one cares beyond their job
5 Your heart is telling you it’s time to leave.
We all know that toxic relationships at work can take a toll on our self-esteem and stress levels, as well as directly affecting our performance and productivity rates. What happens is that sometimes we don’t realize that the people around us are behaving inappropriately towards us.
From the EULEN Flexiplan blog, we would like to share with you some of the signs that, according to psychology experts, can serve as a warning. If you identify some of them in your work environment, it may be time to look for a new office where you can develop as a person and as a professional.
Your colleagues complain incessantly
Even if you are not a complainer, if you surround yourself with colleagues who do complain incessantly, you will end up catching their negativity. If you have identified people with this profile and they are the exception, you don’t need to spend more time with them: they only know how to see the bad side of things.
However, if all your colleagues, in general, speak ill of the company and criticize the relationship with the bosses, this makes the work environment difficult to cope with.
Daily arguments and insults
In toxic companies there are things that are not normal, but their employees have assumed that they were. For example, yelling, arguing and insults. Everyone can lose their temper at some point, but it shouldn’t be the norm. So if you see this kind of behavior in your office every day… check out our website for a new career adventure!
Everyone is looking for a job
Another clear sign that you work in a toxic environment is that most of your colleagues are looking for a new job. This shows that no one feels comfortable there, which may make you reflect on whether you are really comfortable.
No one cares beyond their job
When there is no work unity, each worker prefers to focus on his or her tasks without intruding or caring about the work of others. So, if your co-workers don’t know what you do or you don’t know what they do, ask yourself why. Perhaps no one wants to commit too much to a company where they can’t develop.
Your heart is telling you it’s time to leave.
Your head, coerced by the fear of uncertainty, may be telling you that things are not so bad. But what is your inner voice telling you, what messages are your instincts sending you? When in doubt, try to find a quiet moment to take a deep breath and ask yourself if the time has come to leave the company for good.

Registro
¿Cómo puedo registrarme en EULEN Flexiplan?
Vaya a "Inserte su CV" y cree una cuenta en la sección "Nuevo usuario". Aquí tendrás que rellenar un formulario y aceptar los términos y condiciones de uso. Puedes acelerar este proceso subiendo tu CV o importando tus datos de LinkedIn. Una vez cumplimentado este formulario, recibirás un correo electrónico en la dirección que nos hayas facilitado con las claves de acceso para activar tu cuenta. Es importante que registre la mayor cantidad de información posible. Cuanta más información proporcione, más fácil le resultará encontrar las ofertas de empleo que mejor se adapten a su perfil y a sus expectativas.
¿Qué puedo hacer si olvido mi nombre de usuario y/o contraseña?
Si no recuerda su contraseña o nombre de usuario, tiene la opción de recuperarlos introduciendo el correo electrónico con el que se registró. En este caso, recibirás un código de activación de un solo uso y un enlace que te llevará a una página donde podrás utilizar ese código de activación y elegir una nueva contraseña. Introduzco mi correo electrónico para obtener los códigos. La página me dice que me los han enviado a mi correo electrónico, pero no llegan. En primer lugar, debes asegurarte de que el correo electrónico que te hemos enviado desde EULEN Flexiplan con las claves de acceso no está en la carpeta de SPAM. Si no están en estas carpetas, tendrás que enviarnos un email, explicando la incidencia, te responderemos lo antes posible.
Descubre cómo ver y aplicar a nuestras ofertas de empleo
Accede a nuestras ofertas de empleo
¿Cómo puedo inscribirme en las ofertas?
Entra en la sección "Ofertas de Empleo" y podrás acceder a todas nuestras ofertas e inscribirte en la que más se ajuste a tu perfil. Una vez elegidas las ofertas adecuadas, podrás pinchar en "Solicitud Online" y rellenar los datos solicitados en cada una de ellas. Para realizar esta función debes estar registrado en la web de EULEN Flexiplan.
¿Cómo puedo buscar ofertas?
Desde el apartado "Ofertas de Empleo", la opción "Búsqueda de Ofertas" te dará la posibilidad de encontrar ofertas según los criterios que indiques. Lo más fácil será por "Palabra Clave", también puedes añadir "Organización" en la que puedes indicar el sector de tu preferencia o "Ámbito Profesional" en la que puedes añadir la categoría. Las búsquedas que haya realizado se pueden guardar para acceder a ellas y actualizarlas en cualquier momento. Puede guardar hasta cinco búsquedas diferentes a la vez.
¿Cómo funcionan los procesos de selección?
Cuando te presentas a una oferta de empleo como candidato, nuestros consultores analizan si tus conocimientos, aptitudes e intereses conectan con el puesto al que optas. Si existe un buen encaje, nuestros consultores se pondrán en contacto contigo para explicarte con detalle las diferentes fases del proceso y concertar una entrevista, si estás interesado, con el fin de recabar la máxima información posible que te lleve al éxito en el proceso de selección.
¿Puedo recibir ofertas de empleo por correo electrónico?
Puedes activar las notificaciones para recibir por correo electrónico las ofertas de empleo que se ajusten a tu perfil profesional. Una vez que te hayas registrado, ve a la sección "Mi cuenta" y editando "Correspondencia" haz clic en "Quiero recibir una notificación por correo electrónico cuando se publique un nuevo puesto que se ajuste a mi perfil (notificación de oferta de empleo)". De esta forma tan fácil y sencilla estarás informado de las ofertas que se ajusten a tus expectativas.
¿Cómo puedo actualizar mi CV en medio de un proceso de selección?
Regístrese con sus claves de acceso para acceder a la sección "Mi perfil". Desde aquí podrás actualizar todos los campos que necesites y recargar tu CV. Tus datos se actualizarán automáticamente para ser evaluados por nuestros consultores.
¿Qué puedo hacer si no deseo recibir ninguna comunicación por correo electrónico?
Para modificar o actualizar sus opciones de notificación por correo electrónico, deberá acceder a la sección "Mi cuenta" y editar el campo "Correspondencia". Al quitar la marca de la opción "Deseo recibir una notificación por correo electrónico cuando se publique un nuevo puesto que coincida con mi perfil (notificación de anuncio de empleo)" y/o "Deseo recibir una confirmación por correo electrónico cuando se reciba mi solicitud", se desactivarán.
¿Dónde está la oficina de EULEN más cercana?
En flexiplan.eulen.com/sobre nosotros/donde estamos puedes encontrar todas nuestras oficinas, para que puedas ver cuál es la más cercana a ti. Te animamos a que te pongas en contacto con nosotros.

Da proteção à produtividade: IHARA apresenta portfólio completo para cana, soja e café na Coopercitrus Expo 2026
Empresa destaca tecnologias para o manejo integrado de pragas, doenças e plantas daninhas, com foco em produtividade, sustentabilidade e rentabilidade ao agricultor
Com os desafios impostos pelas mudanças climáticas, pelo aumento da pressão de pragas, doenças e plantas daninhas e pela necessidade de produzir cada vez mais com eficiência, o agricultor brasileiro tem buscado tecnologias que capazes de aliar produtividade, sustentabilidade e rentabilidade. Atenta a esse cenário, a IHARA, empresa de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de defensivos agrícolas, participa da Coopercitrus Expo 2026, realizada entre os dias 27 e 31 de julho, em Bebedouro (SP), apresentando um portfólio completo de soluções voltadas ao manejo integrado de culturas estratégicas, como cana-de-açúcar , soja e café .
Reconhecida por conectar a inovação japonesa às necessidades da agricultura tropical, a IHARA leva ao evento tecnologias desenvolvidas para elevar o controle dos principais detratores de produtividade, contribuindo para decisões mais assertivas no campo.
Segundo o engenheiro agrônomo e gerente de Marketing Regional da IHARA, Michel Tomazela, a participação na Coopercitrus Expo reforça o compromisso da companhia em estar próxima do produtor rural e compartilhar conhecimento técnico. “Mais do que apresentar nosso portfólio, queremos ouvir o agricultor para compreender os desafios de cada safra e contribuir para a melhor tomada de decisão em cada fase do cultivo. Nossas soluções foram desenvolvidas para ampliar a eficiência no campo, preservar o potencial produtivo das lavouras e garantir a rentabilidade do produtor”, afirma Tomazela.
Herbicidas elevam o controle de plantas daninhas
Para impulsionar o manejo de plantas daninhas, a IHARA apresenta o YAMATO SC , herbicida pré-emergente seletivo que combina flexibilidade de aplicação, longo efeito residual e elevado nível de controle, inclusive sobre espécies resistentes. A solução mantém a lavoura protegida por mais tempo e contribui para a preservação do potencial produtivo dos cultivos.
Com registro para culturas como soja, café e cana-de-açúcar, o produto controla importantes plantas daninhas, entre elas capim-pé-de-galinha, capim-colonião, capim-braquiária, capim-colchão, capim-amargoso e caruru, oferecendo alta seletividade e segurança às lavouras.
Outro destaque é o RITMO , herbicida desenvolvido exclusivamente para a cultura da cana-de-açúcar. A tecnologia controla simultaneamente gramíneas e plantas de folhas largas, oferecendo amplo espectro de ação e longo efeito residual. Com isso, o agricultor simplifica o manejo, mantém o canavial protegido por mais tempo e reduz a competição por água, luz e nutrientes, favorecendo o pleno desenvolvimento da cultura.
Inseticidas reforçam o manejo integrado em diferentes culturas
Na linha de inseticidas, a IHARA apresenta o ZEUS , tecnologia consolidada como uma das principais soluções para o controle do Sphenophorus levis , conhecido como bicudo-da-cana. O produto protege a cultura desde a raiz até a parte aérea, mantendo alta eficiência mesmo sob diferentes condições de umidade do solo.
Na soja, o ZEUS também se destaca pelo controle de percevejos, reunindo ação translaminar e sistêmica, além de atuar por contato e ingestão. Seu efeito de choque, aliado ao residual prolongado, proporciona proteção duradoura e elevada eficiência no manejo de pragas.
Outra tecnologia em evidência é o MAXSAN , inseticida que oferece controle diferenciado da cigarrinha-da-cana. O produto atua em todas as fases de desenvolvimento da praga, apresentando efeito ovicida e ação de choque sobre ninfas e adultos, favorecendo a redução populacional também nos ciclos seguintes.
Além da cana-de-açúcar, o MAXSAN também possui importante atuação na cafeicultura, controlando o bicho-mineiro, e na soja, onde apresenta desempenho diferenciado no manejo de todas as fases dos percevejos e da mosca-branca, contribuindo para maior estabilidade produtiva das lavouras.
Fungicidas ampliam a proteção das lavouras
Entre as novidades para a sojicultura está o FUSÃO FIX , fungicida desenvolvido para atuar estrategicamente no fechamento da lavoura, fase decisiva para preservar a sanidade foliar, favorecer o enchimento dos grãos e maximizar o potencial produtivo.
A formulação reúne três princípios ativos que associam ação multissítio, efeito preventivo e protetor, elevada sistemicidade e alta fixação às folhas, proporcionando maior absorção, distribuição e permanência do produto na planta. Além do elevado controle da ferrugem-asiática e de outras doenças da soja, o FUSÃO FIX apresenta alta seletividade, preservando a área foliar ativa e contribuindo para a manutenção do potencial produtivo da lavoura, inclusive com efeito fisiológico positivo sobre os novos crescimentos.
Para a cafeicultura, a IHARA apresenta o SPIRIT SC, solução que reúne ação inseticida e fungicida. Desenvolvido com uma molécula inédita e exclusiva no Brasil, o produto protege o cafeeiro contra importantes ameaças, como bicho-mineiro, ferrugem e cigarra-do-café, proporcionando praticidade operacional e amplo espectro de controle em uma única solução.
Com mais de seis décadas de atuação no Brasil, a IHARA investe continuamente em pesquisa e desenvolvimento para adaptar ao campo brasileiro as tecnologias desenvolvidas por seus acionistas japoneses, reconhecidos entre os maiores desenvolvedores de moléculas para proteção de cultivos do mundo. “Nossa atuação é pautada pela inovação. Trabalhamos para transformar conhecimento em por soluções que atendam às necessidades dos cultivos, oferecendo um portfólio cada vez mais completo, capaz de controlar os principais desafios das lavouras”, conclui Michel Tomazela.
Sobre a IHARA
A IHARA é uma empresa de pesquisa e desenvolvimento que, há mais de 60 anos, leva soluções para a agricultura brasileira, setor no qual é reconhecida como fonte de inovação e tecnologia japonesa, sendo uma marca que possui a credibilidade e a confiança dos seus clientes. A empresa conta com um portfólio completo de fungicidas, herbicidas, inseticidas, biológicos, acaricidas e produtos especiais, somando mais de 60 soluções que contribuem para a proteção de mais de 100 diferentes tipos de cultivos, colaborando para que os agricultores possam produzir cada vez mais alimentos, com mais qualidade e de forma sustentável. Em 2022, a IHARA ingressou no segmento de pastagem, oferecendo soluções inovadoras para o pecuarista brasileiro. Para mais informações, acesse o site da IHARA.

Start
Guten Tag und herzlich willkommen auf unserer Webpräsenz der Schlausitz. Wir, das Team der Lausitzer Bildungsträger gemeinnützige GmbH, stellen Ihnen hier unsere Einrichtungen vor. Das sind unsere Kita Naseweis, in der Kinder von null Jahren bis zur Schuleinführung betreut werden, unsere Grundschule Georg Heinsius von Mayenburg, an der unsere Schüler auf andere Art lernen können und unser Hort, in dem unsere Schulkinder bis in die frühen Abendstunden sicher und gut aufgehoben sind. Sie lesen hier, wie wir arbeiten, wie unsere Kinder hier in Senftenberg-Brieske bei uns spielen und lernen und wie der Übergang zu den weiterführenden Schulen gestaltet wird.
Auch unsere Akademie wird hier vorgestellt. Informieren Sie sich gerne hier im Web. Und wenn Sie dann Lust bekommen, uns näher kennen zu lernen – gerne: Kommen Sie doch bitte nach einem kurzen Anruf oder einer Mail vorbei. Wir freuen uns auf Sie, auf Ihre aufgeweckten Kinder und sagen:
Bis bald wieder in Brieske.
Auf You Tube können Sie gern unseren Imagefilm ansehen. Auch mit dem Fach Spanisch haben unsere Kinder Spaß!

Der bewahrenden, konservativen Tradition einer Medizin, die sich nicht nur auf den einzelnen Krankheitsfall beschränkt, sondern den Menschen in seiner Gesamtheit betrachtet.
Dem Glauben an den Fortschritt der Medizin, der kontinuierlich die Möglichkeit eröffnet, neue Verfahren zur Prävention, Diagnostik und Therapie von Krankheiten anzuwenden.

=== PAGE: about | https://dvsshoes.com/pages/about
About DVS Shoes
Retrieved via http: https://dvsshoes.com/pages/about
DVS Shoes sells a diverse range of performance skate shoes and lifestyle footwear with a focus on originality, quality, and innovation for those who share our passion for skateboarding, surfing, snowboarding, motocross, and defying boundaries.
About
Born on the Board
DVS Shoe Company, founded in 1995 in Los Angeles, California, is a global skate shoe company dedicated to having fun and always pushing forward. We design a diverse range of performance skate shoes and lifestyle footwear with a focus on originality, quality, and innovation for those who share our passion for skateboarding, surfing, snowboarding, motocross, and defying boundaries.
Our Story
We grew up in the golden era of skateboarding, surrounded by the raw energy of LA's skate scene. Back then, skaters needed shoes that could survive kickflips, heelflips, and hours of concrete abuse. Most brands didn't get it. We did. So we built our own.
What started as a crew with a mission became a global footwear brand trusted by riders across skateboarding, surfing, snowboarding, and motocross. Our heritage silhouettes, the Comanche, the Celsius, and the Enduro, became icons in their own right. Today, we keep those classics alive with modern updates, blending the look and feel that made them legendary with the materials and technology that push performance forward.
What We Stand For
Performance first. Every shoe we design starts with how it performs on a board. We develop proprietary technology that gives you better grip, impact protection, and durability where it counts.
Style that crosses over. Our shoes work just as hard off the board as they do on it. We design for the full life of a skater, from the park to the street to wherever the night takes you.
Real culture, not marketing. We don't borrow from skate culture; we're part of it. Our Trick Series blog, our collaborations like DVS x Skate More, and our team riders keep us connected to the community that built us.
Heritage with guts. We respect where we came from, but we never stand still. Every season, we push our designs and our tech further.
Who We're For
If you ride, we made these for you. Skateboarders, surfers, snowboarders, motocross riders, and anyone who lives for that feeling of pushing past what you thought was possible. We build for people who value originality, demand real performance from their gear, and refuse to compromise on style. Our community is loud, creative, and always moving. That's exactly how we like it.
What's Next
After nearly 30 years, we're still hungry. We're developing new technologies, dropping fresh collaborations, and finding new ways to support the riders and creators who keep action sports alive. The road ahead is wide open, and we plan to skate every inch of it.
We offer free shipping on orders over $100 and free 30-day returns , because we want you to feel as confident buying from us as we are making the product.
Thanks for rolling with us. Let's go.

What we do
What is a wellness marketing agency?
A wellness marketing agency is a specialist agency that runs paid media, SEO, and retention marketing for brands in regulated wellness verticals. It is different from a generalist marketing agency because wellness ads run under Meta's Special Ad Category, Google's Healthcare and Medicines policy, the FDA's General Wellness Policy (2019) , and FTC substantiation rules .
A generalist agency that does not know those frameworks will get a med spa's ad account disabled, a supplement brand flagged under Google's YMYL (Your Money or Your Life) guidelines, or a longevity clinic stuck with leads that never convert because the creative cannot speak to the actual outcome. Raging Agency runs ads for wellness brands every day. The compliance fluency is the moat.
Industries we serve
The wellness verticals we specialize in
Raging Agency runs paid media and SEO for ten wellness verticals : wellness clinics, med spas (Botox, Morpheus8, CoolSculpting, GLP-1), recovery centers, HBOT (hyperbaric oxygen), biohacking studios, longevity and hormone clinics (the category driven by figures like Bryan Johnson, Blueprint, and Gary Brecka), functional medicine, wellness gyms, red light therapy, and wellness tech manufacturers (sauna, cold plunge, HBOT, red light). Each vertical has its own ad policy stack, its own LTV math, and its own AI search visibility playbook. We do not work outside these ten.

Vor der Hochzeit
Eheschließung anmelden Sie können Ihre Eheschließung frühestens sechs Monate vor Ihrem Wunschtermin beim Standesamt München anmelden. Bitte beachten Sie: Bestimmte Trausäle und Termine sind sehr begehrt.
Eheschließung anmelden mit auswärtigem Partner Nur einer von Ihnen wohnt in München? In diesem Fall müssen Sie einige weitere Details beachten.
Als auswärtiges Paar in München heiraten Auch wenn beide außerhalb Münchens ihren Wohnsitz haben, können Sie in München heiraten. Wenden Sie sich in diesem Fall zuerst an das Standesamt Ihres Wohnorts.
Heiraten im Ausland In vielen Ländern benötigen Sie für die Hochzeit ein Ehefähigkeitszeugnis.
Tanzkurs machen Der große Tag rückt näher, aber weder Braut noch Bräutigam können tanzen? Hochzeits- oder Auffrischungskurse vermitteln die nötigen Grundlagen für sichere und erste gemeinsame Schritte ins Eheleben.

Nach der Hochzeit
Personalausweis beantragen Sie haben Ihren Nachnamen geändert? Vergessen Sie nicht, einen neuen Ausweis zu beantragen.
Reisepass beantragen Wenn Sie Ihren Nachnamen geändert haben, müssen Sie auch einen neuen Reisepass beantragen. Ein Reisepass mit altem Namen ist ungültig.
Aufenthaltstitel übertragen lassen Sie haben eine ausländische Staatsbürgerschaft? Dann müssen Sie neben Ihrem Pass auch Ihren elektronischen Aufenthaltstitel ändern lassen.
Heirat im Ausland anerkennen lassen Sie haben im Ausland geheiratet? Vergessen Sie nicht, Ihre Ehe in Deutschland nochmals gesondert anerkennen zu lassen.
Namen im Führerschein ändern lassen Kein Muss, aber sinnvoll: Sie können auch einen neuen Führerschein beantragen. Vor allem bei Auslandsreisen kann das hilfreich sein.

Evangelische Heirat planen Zur Vorbereitung der Trauung führen Pfarrerin oder Pfarrer mit den Brautleuten ein Gespräch zu Ehe, Gestaltung des Gottesdienstes und notwendigen Formalitäten.
